meta_title: Andrew Paton Heating & Plumbing | Derby Plumber
meta_description: Andrew Paton Heating & Plumbing Solutions in Derby. Emergency plumbing, boiler repairs, and heating installations. Fast response, local expertise. Call today.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or broken boiler in Derby? We arrive fast, diagnose on site, and fix most jobs the same day.
services_heading: Complete Heating & Plumbing Services Across Derby
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to new boiler installations, we handle all your heating and plumbing needs with speed and skill.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast, any time of day or night. We carry parts on the van and aim to have you back to normal within the hour.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Rapid diagnosis of heating faults, with most repairs completed same day. Annual servicing keeps your boiler running safely and efficiently all winter.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New boiler fitted and commissioned with a 10-year parts and labour warranty. We handle all the paperwork and make sure your system is safe and efficient from day one.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Full heating system design and installation for new properties or upgrades. We ensure your system is balanced, efficient, and saves you money on energy bills.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Repair
services.desc: Cold spots on your radiator? We can bleed, repair, or replace radiators throughout your home, with minimal fuss and disruption.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: New taps, toilets, showers, and full bathroom suites installed to the highest standard. We work neatly and leave your home clean and ready to use.

about_pullquote: I started this because I got fed up watching neighbours being ripped off.
about_para_1: Andrew Paton Heating & Plumbing Solutions was founded on a simple promise: turn up on time, do the job right, and charge a fair price. With 18 years' experience across Derby and the surrounding area, we've earned a reputation for honest, reliable work on everything from emergency burst pipes to brand-new heating systems. We're Gas Safe Registered and carry all accreditations required to work safely and legally.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen, explain what's needed without unnecessary upselling, and finish jobs when we say we will. Every member of the team has been trained to our standards and carries the right tools and parts. Whether you call us at 3am with a frozen pipe or plan a boiler upgrade weeks in advance, you'll get the same professional service and competitive pricing.
reviews_heading: What Derby Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Woke up to a burst pipe on a Saturday morning. Called Andrew at 8am, he was here by 9:15 with all the bits he needed. Fixed it properly, no mess, and charged a fair price. Couldn't ask for better service really.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a new boiler installed last month. The whole process was smooth — Andy explained everything clearly, the lads were polite and efficient, and it was done when they promised. System's running beautifully and the 10-year warranty gives me real peace of mind.
reviews.author: Helen W.

reviews.text: Emergency call-out on Boxing Day because the heating went down. Most companies wouldn't even answer, but Andrew's team got here the same afternoon and had us warm again by evening. Absolute lifesaver. Recommended him to three neighbours already.
reviews.author: David R.
